name: Offbeast

founders.name: Insa Mohr
founders.bio: Insa is the co-founder of Offbeast offering solutions to the meat industry that increase both, margins and climate impact. She has a background in information technologies and finance. But most importantly, she is excited about finding solutions to make the world better and more sustainable. In her spare time, Insa loves tinkering and climbing. She also loves meeting fellow founders - reach out if you want to grab a (virtual) coffee with her!
